privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.lead: This policy explains how WATAD Software («WATAD», «we») collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you visit watadiq.com or work with us as a client.
privacyPage.manageCookiesHint: You can reopen the cookie banner and change your choices at any time.

cookieRows.purpose: Site security, language, session, cookie consent storage.
Understand traffic and improve pages (only if you allow).
Measure campaigns and show relevant offers (only if you allow).

intro.title: Introduction
paragraphs: We respect your privacy and aim to be transparent about the data we process. This policy applies to watadiq.com and related products operated by WATAD Software.
By using our website or services, you acknowledge this policy. Where consent is required (for example non-essential cookies), we ask before enabling those features.

controller.title: Data controller
paragraphs: WATAD Software is the data controller for personal data described in this policy.

collect.title: Information we collect
bullets: Usage data: pages visited, browser type, IP address (truncated where possible), referral URLs.
Communication data: messages you send via contact forms or email.
Cookie preferences: your cookie consent choices stored locally on your device.

cookies.title: Cookies & similar technologies
cookies.lead: We use cookies and local storage to run the site, remember language, and, only with your permission, analytics or marketing tools.
paragraphs: Essential cookies are always active because the site cannot function without them. You control optional categories from the cookie banner or the button at the bottom of this page.

legal.title: Legal bases for processing
bullets: Contract: delivering projects, accounts, and services you request.
Legitimate interests: securing our platform, preventing abuse, improving products.
Consent: non-essential cookies, optional marketing communications.
Legal obligation: responding to lawful requests when required.

use.title: How we use your information
bullets: Respond to inquiries and support requests.
Analyze aggregated usage to improve performance (with consent where required).
Comply with law and enforce our terms.

sharing.title: Sharing & processors
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share data only with trusted processors who help us operate the service (hosting, email delivery, security/CDN), under contracts that require appropriate safeguards.

retention.title: Data retention
bullets: Communication records: retained as needed to respond to inquiries.
Cookie consent: stored locally until you clear browser storage or change preferences.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: We use HTTPS/TLS, rate limiting, and infrastructure protections (WAF/CDN). No method is 100% secure; we continuously improve our controls.

rights.title: Your rights
bullets: Access, correction, or deletion of your personal data where applicable.
Withdraw consent for optional cookies or marketing.
Object to or restrict certain processing under applicable law.
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your country.
rights.note: To exercise rights, email info@watadiq.com. We may need to verify your identity.

children.title: Children
paragraphs: Our services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. Contact us if you believe a child provided personal data.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our practices or legal requirements change. We will post the new version on this page with an updated date. Significant changes may be announced on the website.

about.title: About WATAD
about.intro: WATAD is an official Iraqi software agency specializing in web development, mobile applications, cybersecurity, and digital products that help bold brands grow.

sections.title: Our story
paragraphs: WATAD was founded to give Iraqi businesses and creators the same caliber of digital craftsmanship found in global tech hubs. We combine sharp design, reliable engineering, and security first thinking so every product we ship feels premium and performs under pressure.
From startups launching their first app to established brands refreshing their web presence, we partner closely with clients, translating ambitious ideas into shipped software.

sections.title: Mission
paragraphs: Enable generations of Iraqi entrepreneurs, artists, and organizations to achieve success, impact culture, and shape a better digital future, one product at a time.
list: Build fast, accessible, and beautiful digital experiences.
Protect what matters with modern cybersecurity practices.
Stay close to clients from strategy through launch and beyond.
